profile.name: Shubham Sonar
profile.tagline: Full-Stack Developer · Mobile & Web Engineer building production apps across iOS, Android, and the modern web.
profile.bio: Results-driven Full-Stack Developer with 5.5+ years building high-quality web and mobile applications across iOS, Android, and modern web platforms. I deliver end-to-end solutions with React Native, Angular, React.js, and Node.js — from system design and feature engineering through deployment and post-launch optimization. Experienced across food delivery, fintech, dating, education, and e-commerce, with a strong focus on clean UI/UX, performance, and maintainable code. AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.

experience.role: Senior Full-Stack Developer (React Native + Angular + Node.js)
experience.summary: Architect and ship production-grade cross-platform mobile apps and Angular web dashboards for an active UK user base on iOS, Android, and browser.
highlights: Built a real-time bidirectional chat system with WebSocket and Node.js — sub-100ms message delivery and higher live engagement.
Designed full-stack state management with Redux Toolkit (mobile) and NgRx (Angular web) for complex conversation and multi-step flows.
Developed and consumed REST/GraphQL APIs with OAuth, payment gateways, and FCM push via reusable service modules.
Led cross-team code reviews and architectural standards that improved consistency and cut post-release bugs.

experience.summary: Joined via campus placement and progressed to lead a cross-functional team shipping features across React Native, React.js, and Node.js for multiple client products.
highlights: Delivered full-stack solutions across food delivery, fintech, e-commerce, dating, and education domains.
Spearheaded a UI/UX overhaul (Angular + React.js) that improved retention and engagement across the product suite.
Integrated payment gateways and AI-driven recommendation APIs into e-commerce — higher conversion and AOV.
Established code review standards and sprint planning across concurrent mobile and web workstreams.
